note: CD8 memory layout on CCR7 × CD45RA. Strategy: (1) CD8_Naive anchors on the dense blob at the upper-right corner (CCR7 very high, CD45RA high). (2) CD8_Effector (EMRA) sits to the left of CD8_Naive in the upper CD45RA band. (3) In the lower CD45RA band, CCR7 is bimodal — locate the left edge / shoulder of the CCR7+ peak; CD8_Central_Memory (lymph-node homing) sits at/right of this edge (includes the dense CCR7+ peak), CD8_Effector_Memory sits to its left.
tips: CD8 differentiation subsets (mirror of Step 3 on the CD8 parent). CD8_Naive: CCR7+ CD45RA+. CD8_Central_Memory: CCR7+ CD45RA-. CD8_Effector_Memory: CCR7- CD45RA-. CD8_Effector: CCR7- CD45RA+ (the file label is shorthand for TEMRA). Useful co-markers: CD27/CD28 would refine the differentiation axis but are not in panel; CD57 would identify senescent / terminally differentiated CD8 but is also missing.
